entry.title: Tesla museum in Belgrade reopens after restoration
entry.summary: The museum holds the inventor's notebooks and a working replica of his coil.
entry.content:
The curator said the work took two years.

Letters between the inventor and Ford are shown in a new gallery from Friday.

Visitors can see the replica coil on the ground floor.

entry.title: Regulators propose new caps on card fees
entry.summary: A draft rule would cap the fees merchants pay on debit transactions across the domestic market.
entry.content:
The consultation runs for ninety days and a final rule is expected late in the year.

Bank lobbyists said the change would shift costs onto cardholders.

Shares of $V were little changed after the proposal.

entry.title: Global Desk | Grocery pricing pressure is squeezing margins
entry.summary: Supermarket chains cut list prices on staples for a second quarter running.
entry.content:
Suppliers said Target had pushed hardest on private-label pricing this year.

Analysts said Target would protect trips rather than basket size.

One supplier said Target asked for longer payment terms.

Shelf space at Target for national brands narrowed again, suppliers said.

Additional reporting from the regional bureaux.

entry.title: Port traffic recovered after the strike
entry.summary: Volumes in February were 2 percent above the same month last year.
entry.content:
The port authority said in a statement that container traffic returned to normal levels within three weeks of the settlement.

It said the backlog of vessels waiting at anchor cleared on the ninth of the month.

A spokesperson said rail connections were the last part of the network to recover.

entry.title: Global Desk | In northern woodlands, Caterpillar and moth numbers rebound
entry.summary: Surveys found larvae counts up by a third after two poor seasons.
entry.content:
Warm springs favour the species that feed on birch.

Caterpillar damage was heaviest in the Apple orchards, the survey said.

Additional reporting from the regional bureaux.

entry.title: Visa fees rose for long-stay travellers
entry.summary: The consulate said the new schedule applies to applications filed after April 1.
entry.content:
Tourists on short stays are not affected by the change.

Tourists booking Amazon river cruises need the same documents, the consulate said.

Visa applications from students will be processed under the old fee, the embassy said.

entry.title: Shell approves a North Sea gas development
entry.summary: Shell plc (LSE: SHEL) approved a $2.1 billion North Sea gas development that will feed its liquefied natural gas plant from 2029.
entry.content:
The project is expected to produce 45,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day.

Suppliers will be selected before the end of the year.

entry.title: Amazon basin survey finds insect numbers rebounding
entry.summary: Ecologists said larvae counts in the basin rose for a second season after years of decline.
entry.content:
Caterpillar species tracked by the survey recovered fastest in protected habitat.

Deforestation in the Amazon basin slowed 8 percent, the survey said.

Shell fragments of river molluscs were counted along the same riverbank.

Conservation groups said the canopy is still thinner than in 2015.

entry.title: Five habits that save time in Shell scripting for beginners
entry.summary: The tutorial covers quoting, exit codes and how to keep a script readable in the terminal window.
entry.content:
Bind the Meta key before you start, the tutorial says.

Shell scripts in the examples avoid subshells where a loop will do.

Additional reporting from the regional bureaux.

entry.title: Electric vehicle sales rose across Europe in January
entry.summary: Registrations rose 11 percent across the region, industry data showed.
entry.content:
Incentives in two large markets were extended through the year.

Analysts said Tesla accounted for a fifth of the increase in the quarter.

entry.title: Global Desk | Rival vehicles gain access to charging networks
entry.summary: Three operators said cross-brand access will be available at most sites by the summer.
entry.content:
Operators said Tesla had opened the largest share of its connectors so far.

Analysts said Tesla earns a margin on every session sold to other brands.

One operator said Tesla hardware needed only a firmware change.

Drivers using Tesla connectors pay a small premium, the operators said.

Additional reporting from the regional bureaux.

entry.title: European refiners face a thin quarter
entry.summary: Refining margins in northwest Europe fell to the lowest level in two years.
entry.content:
Traders said Shell had cut runs at two plants in response.

Analysts said Shell would lean on its trading business for the quarter.

One trader said Shell was buying fewer heavy barrels than usual.

Output at Shell facilities in the region fell 5 percent, traders said.

entry.title: Oracle of Delphi site yields new inscriptions
entry.summary: Archaeologists said the inscriptions name two temple officials and a treasurer.
entry.content:
The excavation ran for three seasons on the lower terrace.

One inscription names the Apple of discord, the myth that opens the Trojan war.

Fragments of an earlier sanctuary were found beneath the ruins.

entry.title: Oil prices slip as producers signal higher output
entry.summary: Crude settled 1.4 percent lower after producers signalled that quotas would be relaxed in the second half.
entry.content:
Refining margins in northwest Europe narrowed for a third week in a row.

Shares of $SHEL fell 0.8 percent in London trading.
